If `server_name.yaml` is edited manually, the postinst overwrites it on upgrade. A few points:
* if it's autogenerated, the file should say so
* an upgrade shouldn't touch it anyway (the postinst can tell if it's an upgrade or a fresh install)
* even on fresh install, if the file exists, maybe we should leave it alone?

Update 2019/01/18: likewise, `report_stats.yaml` is also overwritten according to the debconf database. (In some ways this is worse, because it may be some time before the admin notices it.)
